pages.text: With the $(item)Molten Salt Reactors$() you made you gained access to $(item)Nuclear Waste$(). And since you now know how to make $(item)Ender Crystals$(), you could also make $(item)Weather Crystals$().$(br2)With that out of the way, you could now birth a $(item)Venerated World Wyrm$(). It is much more skilled than a normal $(item)World Wyrm$() and can mine for much rarer resources.

We also have a sneaking suspicion that this wyrm can bring home a new type of rare resource.$(br2)Ascend another larvae. Birth another $(item)Reanimated World Wyrm$(). Once you have that you can make quick work of bringing the $(item)Venerated World Wyrm$() into the world.
